column1: # Finnish (fi) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Finnish video-editing vocabulary (aikajana, raita, leike, sekvenssi, kansio, toistopaikka,
# merkki, siirtymä, avainkehys). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product
# UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are imperatives ("Tallenna
# nimellä…"), labels use sentence case, quotation marks are ”…”, and product and format
# names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A
# native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = leike, track = raita, sequence = sekvenssi, timeline = aikajana, bin = kansio,
# playhead = toistopaikka, marker = merkki, In/Out point = alku-/loppupiste, keyframe =
# avainkehys, frame = kuva, caption = tekstitys, preset = esiasetus, template = malli, workspace =
# työtila, gain = vahvistus, opacity = peittävyys, render = renderöinti, ripple = siirtävä,
# dissolve = ristikuva, wipe = pyyhkäisy, voice-over = selostus, proxy = välityskopio, guide =
# apuviiva, shortcut = pikanäppäin, (Legacy) = (vanha).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see fi.tsv.attribution.
